text:
emily: Quick kickoff for SprintBurst microexperiment. Goal: compare two credit grants + one prompt kit, measure 7-day activation (first successful generation + return session). Need owners for copy, tracking, and webinar routing.

raj: I can own tracking + schema. Canonical events: `signup_ref`, `sb_cohort`, `credit_grant`, `prompt_kit`, `gen_first_success`, `session_two`. Add `nudge_displayed` and `activation_7d`. Example payload: `{"uid":"...","sb_cohort":"75_core","credit_grant":75}`

carla: Cohorts proposal: `75_core` = 75 credits + core kit, `250_pro` = 250 credits + pro kit, `control` = baseline. Channel splits: docs, blog, webinar. Primary KPI = % activation_7d; secondary = avg tokens first session and 14-day retention.

jon: Copy (two quick variants):
- Short: "SprintBurst is live — free credits + starter prompts to prototype fast. Live demo in our kickoff webinar. -> [link]"
- Narrative: "Build and ship LLM features quicker with SprintBurst: credits, curated prompts, and a short live demo. Reserve a spot to see product examples. -> [link]"
Email microcopy: "Your SprintBurst credits are ready. Run a starter prompt to see results. Join our webinar for tips." CTA text for webinar links: "Reserve my seat" (use this across posts).

emily: Link tagging/CRM: use `utm_campaign=sprintburst_q2&utm_source=social&utm_medium=post`. CRM campaign = `sprintburst_q2`. Routing rule: if `utm_source=webinar` or signup path = webinar-reg, enroll in webinar nurture sequence and tag `lead_source:webinar`.

raj: Will add `sprintburst_exposed=true` to user profile on exposure, push experiment flags and UTM parsing, and publish schema. Timeline: schema Wed EOD, flags live Fri AM.

carla: Sampling: deterministic hash on user_id to keep stable assignment. Target N = 6k (approx 3600/1200/1200). I'll drop the allocation script in the repo and share test harness.

jon: Recommend 3-email webinar nurture (reminder, 1 hour, last call) + post-webinar follow-up with quickstart link that auto-applies credits. Also include a small in-app nudge shown on first sign-in for exposed cohorts.

ops-bot: Created campaign record `marketing::sprintburst_q2` and scheduled reminder at 4076600000.

emily: Final action items:
- @raj: push schema + flags (due Wed EOD)
- @jon: finalize 2 social variants + 3-email copy (due Thu noon)
- @carla: confirm allocation & sampling script (due Thu EOD)
- @emily: create CRM campaign + UTM checklist (due Thu EOD)
Run window: 14 days with snapshots at day 7 and day 14 (metrics: activation_7d, avg_tokens_first_week, D14 retention). :rocket:
